title: 海辺と水平線
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original square environment illustration for a Japanese creative website's scene chooser. Complete actual illustrated scenery, refined professional background artwork with convincing depth, material texture, soft natural daylight, restrained warm-neutral colour and delicate lines. Clearly show the specified actual scene, no title-only placeholder. Large readable environment fills image, foreground/middle/background connected in consistent perspective. No people, no faces or human-shaped shadows, no artist references, no copying existing artworks, no lantern, no fantasy glow, no logos, no text/labels, no collage or multi-panel contact sheet. Exactly one finished image. Scene: Japan's quiet rocky and sandy coast at daylight. Foreground pale beach, a few wet stones and small surf edges, middle ground turquoise-to-blue sea with visible wave spacing, background uninterrupted level far horizon and soft clouds. Shoreline leads gently into distance, sea/sky scale convincing, no houses, lighthouse, boats, people or sunburst. Clear wide open feeling and real sea horizon.
processing: Original generated resolution kept; RGB JPEG q85 encoding only

visualQA.method: Individual review of the full generated output; file checks are separate from visual scene assessment.
visualQA.observations: 前景の岩と砂浜、海の波、遠い水平線が読み取れる。空と海の境界は連続し、人物や街の見本へすり替わっていない。
